title: I've built a destruction game with Claude
author: Poptocrack
selftext:
I've build a fully destructible game with Claude over the last months, the Steam page of [Sorry About Your House](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5328510/Sorry_About_Your_House/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=boss) has now been released !

In this game, you will be given tasks to destroy buildings. You can achieve it with your hammer, a big crane or some TNT, air strikes and nukes !

The whole game is made of bricks and the destruction is bound to physics laws (almost perfect!)

This is a coop game from 1 to 4 (?more?) players;

In it you'll find levels like the full scale eiffel tower, golden gate, even lava boss that I'm working on.

Regarding the workflow: 

The code itself has been done with Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1,  
Godot engine,  
All the assets are either pure code or models from itch.

I'll alos share the updates I've made to the visuals and engine over time!
